resources.string: Signed in with an account before? Just sign in again. If not, use the recovery code or the QR code from your old device.
Signing in with an account or a code needs the internet to download your groups. What you typed is kept.
12 letters and numbers. Dashes are optional.
Scan the QR code from your old device
There: Profile › Recovery › Show QR code
Code not found. Check the letters and try again.
Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Couldn\'t sign in right now. Try again.
